units.text: Aspose.Font FOSS for Python reads .ttf fonts and converts them to web-ready formats. It builds optimized font packages for the web, generates quality assurance reports, and creates variable font instances with naming policies. The product supports variable font inspection, subsetting, and compatibility checking through dedicated classes.

It exposes variable font axes and named instances through the TtfFont.axes and TtfFont.named_instances members, resolves coordinates for named instances using smart_instancer.resolve, suggests axis values with smart_instancer.suggest_axis_values, retrieves localized labels and language profiles via VariableAxis.localized_labels and VariableAxis.language_profiles, and presents axis and instance data in user-friendly formats using VariableAxis.to_presentation and VariableInstance.to_presentation.

It builds optimized web font packages with WebFontOptimizer.build, generates CSS and specimen HTML using WebFontOptimizer.build_fonts_css and WebFontOptimizer.build_specimen_html, produces decision reports via WebFontOptimizer.generate_decision_report, and exposes readiness, size summary, and write_to on WebFontOptimizerPackage for deployment.

It builds QA packages and full reports using FontQaReporter.build_package and FontQaReporter.build_full_report, and exports reports in HTML, JSON, Markdown, and PDF formats via FontQaReport.write_html, FontQaReport.write_json, FontQaReport.write_markdown, FontQaReport.write_pdf, FontQaReport.to_dict, and FontQaReport.to_json.

It subsets fonts by text, codepoints, glyph IDs, or presets using FontSubsetter.subset_by_text, FontSubsetter.resolve_codepoints, FontSubsetter.subset, and FontSubsetter.subset_by_presets, supports variable fonts with FontSubsetter.subset_variable_font, analyzes coverage with FontSubsetter.analyze_coverage and FontSubsetter.analyze_web_coverage, and provides web-optimized presets via FontSubsetter.available_presets.

It builds axis sweep, named instance, and showcase packages using AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_axis_sweep_package, AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_named_instance_path, and AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_path_showcase_package, generates review and export packages with AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_path_review_package and AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_export_package, and constructs paths and packages for animation previews via AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_path and AnimationPreviewBuilder.build_path_package.

It compares fonts and variable instances using CompatibilityChecker.compare_fonts and CompatibilityChecker.compare_variable_instances, reports compatibility status with CompatibilityReport.is_compatible, and exports compatibility data in JSON and dictionary forms via CompatibilityReport.to_dict, CompatibilityReport.to_json, and CompatibilityReport.write_json, while DeltaInspector.inspect_variable_glyph, DeltaInspector.inspect_variable_text, DeltaInspector.compare_variable_glyph, DeltaInspector.compare_variable_text, and DeltaInspector.build_delta_sheet provide detailed glyph- and text-level delta analysis.

It loads fonts from paths, bytes, or streams using FontLoader.open and FontLoader.load, and parses TTF, CFF, CFF2, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT, and Type 1 fonts as TtfFont, CffFont, Cff2Font, WoffFont, Woff2Font, EotFont, and Type1Font, while FontSourceInfo.is_path and FontSourceInfo.is_bytes identify the source type.

It provides a CLI via aspose_font.cli.main and an MCP server via aspose_font.mcp.main, exposing commands for font conversion, subsetting, web building, variable font compatibility, font info, glyph outline, and text layout through aspose_font.mcp.font_convert, aspose_font.mcp.font_subset, aspose_font.mcp.web_build, aspose_font.mcp.var_compat, aspose_font.mcp.font_info, aspose_font.mcp.glyph_outline, aspose_font.mcp.text_layout, and aspose_font.mcp.web_family_package.
The first example opens a variable font file and uses WebFontOptimizer to build a web-optimized package with Latin coverage and WOFF support, then writes the result to a specified directory.

The second example opens a variable font file and uses FontQaReporter to build a quality assurance package with Latin coverage and a named preview instance, then prints paths to the generated JSON, HTML, and preview files.

Aspose.Font FOSS for Python supports variable-font workflows through FontLoader.open, axis inspection, named-instance resolution, and smart instancing. Example 004 demonstrates discovery of variable axes, presets, localized labels, and coordinate formatting.
Inspect variable axes, named instances, and localized labels for Roboto-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf.

Aspose.Font FOSS for Python provides tools for font processing, including loading, subsetting, optimization, and quality assurance. It exposes core functionality through entry-point classes such as FontLoader, WebFontOptimizer, and FontQaReporter.

The aspose_font module serves as the top-level namespace for font processing operations, exposing core classes including FontLoader for loading fonts, WebFontOptimizer for web font optimization, and FontQaReporter for quality assurance reporting.
FontLoader provides methods to load font data from files, with open and load methods supporting different input patterns for TTF and variable fonts.
WebFontOptimizer builds optimized web font packages, supporting preset-based subsetting, specimen generation, and decision reports, with output written via WebFontOptimizerPackage.write_to.
FontQaReporter builds quality assurance packages and full reports for fonts, with FontQaReport instances supporting export to HTML and JSON formats.
FontSubsetter supports subsetting fonts for web use, by presets, by text, and with coverage analysis via analyze_coverage.
TtfFont exposes variable font capabilities including axes, named instances, and smart instancing via get_axis, axes, named_instances, and smart_instancer.
VariableAxis represents a variable font axis with properties such as name, localized_labels, language_profiles, and a to_presentation method.
VariableInstance represents a specific instance of a variable font with methods to format_coordinates, access localized_labels, and to_presentation.
CompatibilityChecker compares fonts and variable instances, producing CompatibilityReport instances with an is_compatible property.
DeltaInspector inspects and compares variable font glyphs and text, supporting inspect_variable_glyph, inspect_variable_text, and compare_variable_glyph operations.
AnimationPreviewBuilder builds axis sweep and path animations for variable fonts, with build_axis_sweep, build_path, and build_path_review_package methods.
The aspose_font.cli.main entry point provides command-line interface functionality for font processing operations.
Aspose.Font FOSS for Python reads and writes .ttf font files and supports CffFont, Cff2Font, WoffFont, and Woff2Font formats.
The package requires Python version 3.10 or higher.
The package supports only .ttf as an input format and does not support EotFont or Type1Font.
The package provides access to variable font tables hvar, vvar, cvar, mvar, and get_gvar_table on TtfFont but does not expose additional variable font processing capabilities beyond these members.

The package exposes available_naming_strategies and preview_naming_policy on TtfFont and NamingPolicyPreview with to_dict and name_ids members but does not provide naming policy creation or modification beyond these.

The package exposes available_languages, language_profiles, localization_coverage, and localized_labels on VariableAxis but does not expose VariableInstance or requested_language_hints beyond what is listed.

The package exposes build_baseline_report, measure_workflow_performance, and run_performance_regression_check in the performance module but does not expose additional performance analysis capabilities beyond these.
ActiveTupleSummary represents a summary of active variation tuples for a variable font glyph.
AnimationAsset represents an asset used in font animation sequences.
AnimationFramePackage represents a package of frames for font animation output.
AnimationPreset defines a reusable configuration for font animation settings.
AnimationPreviewBuilder constructs preview representations for font animation sequences.
AnimationReviewPackage packages animation assets for review purposes.
AnimationShowcasePackage packages animation assets for showcase presentations.
AnimationStep represents a single step in a font animation sequence.
AxisRecord describes a variation axis in a variable font.
CffFont represents a font in Compact Font Format (CFF).
ClosePath represents a path-closing command in font outline data.
CompatibilityChecker compares font instances to determine compatibility.
CompatibilityReport summarizes compatibility issues between font instances.
CompositeComponentMovement describes movement of components in a composite glyph.
CompositeGlyphComponent represents a single component in a composite glyph.
CurveTo represents a cubic Bézier curve command in font outline data.
DeltaInspector analyzes variation deltas for font glyphs and text.
DeltaPoint represents a single point in a variation delta.
DeltaTupleReport summarizes variation delta information for a tuple.
FamilyReviewExportPackage packages font family data for review export.
Font represents a font file and its associated data and operations.
FontConversionException is raised when font conversion fails.
FontEncoding describes the character encoding of a font.
FontException is raised for general font processing errors.
FontLoader provides methods to load font files.
FontMetrics contains typographic measurements for a font.
FontNotSupportedException is raised when a font format is not supported.
FontParseException is raised when font parsing fails.
FontPreviewBuilder constructs preview images for font instances.
FontSubsetter creates subsets of fonts for web or print use.
FontType indicates the format category of a font file.
FvarTable contains variation axis definitions for a variable font.
Glyph represents a single character glyph in a font.
GlyphAccessor provides access to glyph data within a font.
GlyphCompatibilityIssue describes a compatibility problem for a specific glyph.
GlyphDeltaComparisonReport compares variation deltas for a glyph across instances.
GlyphDeltaReport summarizes variation delta information for a glyph.
GlyphId uniquely identifies a glyph within a font.
GlyphInterpolationIssue describes a problem with glyph interpolation.
GlyphNotFoundException is raised when a requested glyph is missing.
GlyphOutlineStats represents statistics about glyph outlines.
GlyphPath represents a sequence of path commands that define a glyph outline.
KernPair represents a kerning pair consisting of two glyph identifiers and a kerning value.
LanguageProfile represents a set of language tags supported by a font.
LineTo represents a line-to path command in a glyph outline.
LocalizationCoverage reports how many requested languages are available, matched, and missing.
LocalizationResolution indicates whether a localization request was an exact match.
MoveTo represents a move-to path command in a glyph outline.
NamedInstance represents a named instance defined in a font's name table.
PathCommand is the base class for path commands in glyph outlines.
PlatformNamingDiagnostics provides diagnostics for platform-specific naming.
PreviewImage represents a rendered preview image of a font instance.
QuadraticTo represents a quadratic Bezier curve-to path command in a glyph outline.
RequestedLanguageHint indicates whether a requested language label is present.
ResolvedInstance represents a resolved font instance with its label and coordinates.
SmartInstancer provides methods to instantiate, inspect, and compare font instances.
StatNamingDiagnostics provides diagnostics for STAT table naming.
TextDeltaComparisonReport summarizes differences between two text renderings.
TextDeltaReport summarizes glyph-level differences in a text rendering.
TtfFont represents a font file in the specified format.
TupleScalarDelta represents a scalar delta applied to a variation tuple.
Type1Font represents a font file in the specified format.
UnsupportedFontFormatException is raised when a font format is not supported.
VariableAxis represents a variation axis in a variable font.
VariableAxisPreset defines standard variation axis presets.
VariableInstance represents a specific instance of a variable font.
WebFontAsset represents a single web font asset file.
WebFontBuilder constructs web font packages from font instances.
WebFontBundle represents a collection of web font assets for one instance.
WebFontFamilyPackage represents a complete family package for web deployment.
WebFontOptimizer optimizes fonts for web use with subsetting and optimization.
WebFontOptimizerPackage represents the result of web font optimization.
Woff2Font represents a font file in the specified format.
WoffFont represents a font file in the specified format.
AnimationExportPackage represents a package for exporting animated font previews.
CffCharset represents the charset table in a CFF font.
CffDict represents a dictionary in a CFF font.
CffEncoding represents the encoding table in a CFF font.
CffIndex represents an index table in a CFF font.
PrivateDict represents the private dictionary in a CFF font.
TopDict represents the top-level dictionary in a CFF font program.
PrivateDictOp represents an operator in a CFF PrivateDict.
TopDictOp represents an operator in a CFF TopDict.
CurveAdapter provides methods to convert between cubic and quadratic Bézier curve segments.
FontConverter provides functionality to convert fonts between different formats.
EotHeader represents the header structure of an EOT font.
CffSerializer serializes font data into the Compact Font Format.
EotSerializer serializes font data into the EOT format.
TtfSerializer serializes font data into the TTF format.
Type1Serializer serializes font data into PostScript Type 1 format, supporting both PFA and PFB encodings.
TtfTableSet provides access to raw table data and allows setting it.
TtcFaceRecord represents a single face record within a TTC file.
TtfGlyphParser parses glyph data from font files.
TtfInstancer provides methods to instantiate variable fonts at specific axis values.
AvarTable stores axis variation mapping data for variable fonts.
CmapTable stores character to glyph mapping information.
FeatureVariationRecord describes a feature variation rule in a variable font.
FeatureVariationTable contains feature variation rules for variable fonts.
GlyfTable stores the actual glyph outline data.
HMetric holds horizontal metrics for a single glyph.
HeadTable contains global information about the font.
HheaTable provides horizontal header metrics for the font.
HmtxTable stores horizontal metrics for all glyphs.
HvarTable stores horizontal variation data for variable fonts.
KernTable stores kerning pair information for the font.
LocaTable stores offsets to glyph data in the glyf table.
MaxpTable contains maximum profile information for the font.
NameTable stores typographic names such as family and style names.
Os2Table contains OS/2 and Windows specific metrics and metadata.
PostTable stores PostScript information for the font.
AvarAxisMap defines the mapping of normalized axis values in the avar table.
CmapSubtable represents a single subtable within the character mapping table.
GvarTable stores glyph variation data for variable fonts.
TupleVariation describes a single variation tuple within the gvar table.
DeltaSetIndex specifies a set of variation deltas for a given item.
DeltaSetIndexMap maps items to their corresponding delta set indices.
ItemVariationData stores variation delta data for a subset of items.
ItemVariationStore holds all variation data for horizontal metrics in a variable font.
VariationRegion defines a region in variation space for horizontal variation data.
VariationRegionAxis describes a single axis within a variation region.
The NameRecord class represents a single name table record containing a name identifier, platform, encoding, language, and the actual name string.
The AfmData class holds metrics and metadata for a Type 1 font extracted from an AFM file, including glyph metrics, kerning data, and font-wide information.
The AfmGlyphMetric class describes the horizontal and vertical metrics for a single glyph in a Type 1 font, such as character width, bounding box, and ligature information.
The PfbSegment class represents a segment of a PFB file, containing either ASCII or binary data from a Type 1 font program.
The Type1FontData class encapsulates the complete data for a Type 1 font, including metrics from AFM and the binary program from PFB segments.
The Type1Interpreter class interprets Type 1 font program data to reconstruct glyph outlines and metrics.
